Led frontend development across 12+ client projects using React, JavaScript, and Webflow, building responsive
interfaces and reusable components for production applications.

Developed custom backend integrations using Xano as an API and data layer, implementing application logic and
data models supporting 50K+ records across multiple products.

workflows with payments, geolocation, and transactional communication services.
